description: Reads back a registered Open Design artifact: its manifest, entry file content, supporting file list, and the user's unaddressed comments from the browser preview or VS Code ('openComments', status open or sent). Each comment names its element (selector, text excerpt, htmlHint, rect) and its note; up to 4 comment screenshots are attached as images, newest first, and every comment's screenshot path is listed. Call it when the user says they left comments; address each one, then pass their ids as resolvedCommentIds to register_open_design_artifact. With critique: true it instead returns what the design critic judges (the open-design-critique skill): the recorded brief, title and skill id, the design system's DESIGN.md, the latest saved check run's findings and screenshot paths, and the last critique, with that run's screenshots attached.

critique.description: Return the critique input instead of the entry content and comments. Default false.

entryPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the artifact's entry file.

name: get_open_design_artifact
title: Get a design
